crossRefs.note: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God…
Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

translations.web: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
translations.bsb: He keeps company with evildoers and walks with wicked men.
translations.kjv: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
translations.asv: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men?
